recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban portrait of two men under cool blue lighting, framed by a vertical sawtooth geometric border on the left and a bold, multi-layered typographic block.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical sawtooth pattern creates a rhythmic border against the organic forms of the subjects.
Cool blue highlights on the subjects contrast with deep black shadows.
Bold red rectangular block anchors the primary text against the dark background.
Diagonal positioning of the two subjects creates depth and dynamic movement.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two men positioned diagonally; one in the upper right (larger scale) and one in the lower center (smaller scale).
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red rectangular block containing the first part of the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red block, moves right to the upper subject, then down to the lower subject, following the diagonal line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows occupy the central and lower-left areas, providing a canvas for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and midnight blue for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue for highlights on skin and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary text background block.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between bright blue highlights and absolute black; low saturation except for the red accent.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphen is centered vertically relative to the condensed caps.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the dark background and sawtooth border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed display paired with a wide, italicized humanist sans for contrast in scale and rhythm.
graphicDevices: Vertical sawtooth border (alternating grey and white triangles)

preserve: Condensed nature of the primary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the display text.
Provides the necessary humanist contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of two men in urban attire (jackets, sunglasses) in a dark setting. Use harsh blue directional lighting from the top right. On the far left, include a vertical border of repeating sharp triangles (sawtooth) in alternating grey and white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a bold red rectangle on the left-middle. Overlay white extra-condensed sans-serif text across the rectangle and extending right. Below that, add a smaller, wide-tracked, italicized sans-serif subtitle in off-white.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting predominantly blue and high-contrast?
Is the sawtooth border present on the left edge?
Is the primary text block anchored by a red rectangle?
Are the two subjects positioned on a diagonal axis?

adjustableVariables: Position of the red text block
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red block does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the sawtooth pattern is sharp and consistent.
Check that the blue highlights feel integrated into the scene, not like a filter.
Confirm the condensed font is legible against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Blue Chiaroscuro + Sawtooth Border + Red Block Typography
